description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing and comparison of different grep engines within git-log. It includes setup, environment configuration, and execution of multiple grep engine tests with various patterns, as well as comparisons of their outputs.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out the working tree for testing.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if prerequisites like PCRE are available.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified grep engine and pattern.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expectation that should succeed.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two output files for equivalence.
